title: unified-rollouts: add automated canary/A-B/shadow rollback workflow + observability
author: Priya Menon
description: Motivation: production rollouts frequently require coordinated canary/A-B/shadow strategies plus automated rollback if key SLOs regress. This PR implements a reusable rollout workflow that supports conditional weighted canaries, A/B experiments, and shadow probing with automated rollback triggers based on composite metrics. The change includes: rollout controller updates (policy evaluation and state machine), integration with telemetry/alerts, new e2e/integration tests, SDK route flags for canary/AB/shadow traffic, and console UI hooks for rollout visualization. Checklist: - [x] rollout engine state machine, canary/AB/shadow branches - [x] metric-driven rollback policies (latency, error-rate, ai-quality delta) - [x] composite/quorum logic for noisy metrics - [x] traceable rollout events + audit logs - [x] observability dashboards and alerts - [x] unit/integration/e2e tests - [x] docs and SDK examples - [x] migration notes for existing rollout configs The description below summarizes commits, changed areas, review thread, CI, and merge details.
commits: feat(rollouts): introduce rollout state machine and evaluation loop
feat(rollouts): add weighted canary + conditional AB routing
feat(rollouts): add shadow probing stage and quorum-based decisioning
feat(observability): emit rollout_event metrics and audit log entries
fix(telemetry): normalize latency histograms used by rollback evaluator
test(rollouts): add unit tests for composite metric quorum logic
test(e2e): add end-to-end canary -> rollback scenarios
docs(rollouts): document new policy schema and console integration
chore(sdk): expose route flags for canary/ab/shadow in TS/Py SDKs
review_comments: Marcus Li (reviewer): Overall design looks solid. Two requests before approving: (1) make quorum threshold configurable per-metric and per-rollout, (2) add one e2e that simulates jittery telemetry to validate grace window handling.
Priya Menon (author): Thanks Marcus — added quorumThreshold to policy schema and wired it into the evaluator; added e2e jitter test (tests/e2e/rollouts/canary_jitter_test.go).

Ava Keller (reviewer): Nit: split the long evaluate loop in policy_evaluator.go into smaller functions to improve testability. Also please add a comment on the expected aggregation latency assumptions.
Priya Menon (author): Refactored evaluate loop into evaluateWindow, computeCompositeScore, and decideStep; added comment about aggregation window defaults and CR. PTAL.
Diego Alvarez (reviewer): Observability pieces look good. One ask: include a rollout_id tag in the latency histogram to make per-rollout drilling feasible.
Priya Menon (author): Added rollout_id label to histograms and updated dashboards to support it.
Samir Patel (SRE): CI e2e flake observed on first run (timeout in canary_jitter_test). Increased test timeouts and added retry harness; reran e2e suite — green now.
ci_checks: e2e-tests: pass (first run had a timeout, rerun passed 980s)
release_notes: Add rollout workflow supporting weighted canary, A/B experiments, and shadow probing with metric-driven auto-rollback. Includes telemetry, dashboards, and e2e tests. Migration: rollout policy v2 adds configurable quorumThreshold; run scripts/migrate-rollout-configs/2026-02-add-policy-version.sh to upgrade existing configs.
notes_for_ops: When rolling this out to Dedicated clusters, ensure telemetry pipeline retention is at least 5m to preserve aggregation windows. The migration script is idempotent; run on control plane before node pools pick up new agent images.
testing_summary: Added unit tests for quorum/composite scoring, integration tests for AB routing, and two e2e scenarios: (1) canary->rollback on latency/error regression, (2) shadow probing with quorum decisioning. Increased e2e timeouts to reduce CI flakes.
changelog_entry: unified-rollouts: v2 rollout policies + automated rollback workflow (canary/AB/shadow) — added observability and tests
backcompat: policy v1 remains supported; v2 is opt-in. Migration helper provided.
confidence_notes: Primary risk is telemetry lag; mitigations: configurable graceWindow, quorum thresholds, and canary weight caps. SRE validated scenarios on staging and Dedicated canary cluster.
